summary: Fidelity Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting monthly distributions and a fact sheet. Declared $0.1750 gross per share for Class I/S/D, plus a $0.0160 variable supplemental distribution, payable June 30, 2026. Also disclosed April 2026 NAV per class (~$24.89-$24.91), aggregate NAV of $1.4B, portfolio fair value $2.5B, debt principal $1.2B (0.89x debt/equity). Continuously offering up to $4.0B in shares. This is a routine periodic operational update; no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event.
